create_reduction_count_nonzero: create a reduction that counts non-zero elements in a tensor along a specified axis
create_reduction_argmax_argmin: create reductions that find indices of maximum and minimum values in a tensor along an axis
create_reduction_sum_mean_std_var: create reductions that compute sum, mean, standard deviation, and variance of tensor elements
create_reduction_quantile_median: create reductions that compute quantiles and median values of a tensor along an axis
create_reduction_weighted_average: create a weighted average reduction of a tensor with optional weights and axis specification
